records.name: Buchanan Street Mall Renovation Project
records.summary: City park and pedestrian walkway that runs through a five-block section of the Western Addition, from Eddy Street to Grove Street.

records.name: Buena Vista Park Improvement Project
records.summary: Extensive improvements to the paved path network.

records.name: Community Opportunity Fund (COF)
records.summary: This initiative of 2020 Health and Recovery Bond that provides an opportunity for San Franciscans to nominate park capital projects for funding.

records.name: Crocker Amazon Baseball and Softball Fields Renovation
records.summary: This project would fully renovate the baseball and softball fields at Crocker Amazon.

records.name: Embarcadero Plaza and Sue Bierman Park Renovation Project
records.summary: This project will transform Embarcadero Plaza and Sue Bierman Park into a vibrant, five-acre park at the heart of San Francisco.

records.name: Gene Friend Recreation Center
records.summary: Completed August 2026. Construction of a new recreation center to replace existing building.

records.name: Golden Gate Park
records.summary: Active projects in Golden Gate Park, including Kezar Pavilion and Senior Center Outdoor Recreation Area.

records.name: India Basin Waterfront Park
records.summary: Development of a new, 10-acre waterfront park with parks, trails, and a comprehensive set of programs and amenities.

records.name: Jackson Playground Improvement Project
records.summary: Renovation of entire park, including accessibility improvements and reinvigorated clubhouse.

records.name: Japantown Peace Plaza Renovation Project
records.summary: Renovated plaza including improvements to paving, planting, seating, and central gathering space.

records.name: Jefferson Square ADA Path Improvements
records.summary: This project will perform maintenance along the southern and western park edges to improve accessibility, infrastructure, and overall user experience.

records.name: Kezar Pavilion Renovation Project
records.summary: Renovation of this legendary park facility to create a flexible and multi-purpose facility to accommodate more recreational activities and to better function as a disaster response facility in the event of a major emergency.

records.name: Koshland Park Improvement Project
records.summary: This project will enhance accessibility, improve site stability, and expand opportunities for community use throughout this vital green space.

records.name: Lake Merced West
records.summary: Construction of new recreational elements around this unique waterfront setting.

records.name: Marina Improvement and Remediation Project
records.summary: Environmental remediation, environmental stewardship, trail improvements, and increased public access and recreational amenities.

records.name: McLaren Park
records.summary: Active projects in McLaren Park, including Herz Rec Center, Louis Sutter Playground, Shelley Promenade, and Yosemite Creek Daylighting.

records.name: Minnie and Lovie Ward Athletic Fields Renovation
records.summary: This project will remove and replace the existing synthetic field turf on the playfields.

records.name: Mission Bay Future Parks Project
records.summary: This project will design and develop five open space parcels as part of Mission Bay Parks.

records.name: Mission Creek Park South Extension Project
records.summary: This project will expand existing bike and pedestrian routes throughout Mission Creek Park completing the last link in a string of Mission Bay’s creekside open spaces.

records.name: Ocean Beach Climate Adaptation Project
records.summary: Enhancing recreational and open space elements, including planned improvements to trails, restrooms, beach access stairs, and parking lots.

records.name: Portsmouth Square Improvement Project
records.summary: This project will completely renovate the park with funding from the 2020 Health and Recovery Bond.

records.name: Rachele Sullivan Park Project
records.summary: Future park site at 11th and Natoma totaling .48 acres.

records.name: Randolph-Bright Mini Park Children’s Play Improvements
records.summary: Renovation of Mini Park to add children’s nature exploration area and improve pathways and access points.

records.name: San Francisco Irish Famine Memorial Project
records.summary: This project will construct a concrete platform and guardrail to host future artwork, such as informational plaques and a statue memorializing the Great Famine (1845-1852).

records.name: Silver Terrace Children's Play Improvements
records.summary: Renovation of the playground with a nature-forward design, as well as improvements to irrigation, landscaping, fencing, and picnic seating.

records.name: South Sunset Clubhouse Renovation
records.summary: Completed August 2026. Reconfiguration and renovation of the interior of Clubhouse, as well as access improvements, landscaping, and beautification.

records.name: Sunset Dunes
records.summary: Run, stroll or roll--- anyone, including bikers, joggers, pedestrians and skaters, can use this route and enjoy nature.

records.name: Twin Peaks Trails Improvement & Promenade Project
records.summary: Improve the main trail, repair existing trails and steps, eliminate social trails, and additional wayfinding signage.

records.name: Golden Gate Park - Blue Heron Boatshed
records.summary: This project will demolish the existing boatshed and build a new, larger boatshed in its place.

records.name: Golden Gate Park - JFK Access and Safety Improvements
records.summary: The Golden Gate Park Access and Safety Program includes a number of initiatives to improve safety, equity, accessibility and mobility along JFK Promenade.

records.name: Golden Gate Park - Senior Center Outdoor Recreation Area
records.summary: This project will create an outdoor recreation space adjacent to the Senior Center to support and increase capacity for group fitness activities.

records.name: McLaren Park - Louis Sutter Playground ADA
records.summary: This project will remove existing barriers to public accessibility in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

records.name: McLaren Park - Louis Sutter Upper Playground Renewal
records.summary: This project will fully renovate the playground adjacent to McNab Lake.

records.name: McLaren Park - Pedestrian, Bike and Streetscape Projects
records.summary: The McLaren Park Pedestrian, Bike and Streetscape Projects is an effort to improve safety for people walking, biking, taking transit and driving on McLaren Park’s streets and wide pathways, including: Visitacion Avenue; Sunnydale Avenue; Crocker Amazon access; and John Shelley Drive Promenade.

records.name: McLaren Park - Shelley Promenade Project
records.summary: Approved October 2023. This project converted nearly half-mile section of Shelley Drive in McLaren Park to a car-free promenade to improve safety and comfort for all park users.

records.name: McLaren Park - Trails Improvement Project
records.summary: The improvements proposed by the McLaren Park Vision Plan build on the existing trail network, including Philosopher’s Way.

records.name: McLaren Park - Vision Plan
records.summary: The Recreation and Park Department will be investing $6 million of 2020 Bond funding in McLaren Park. Learn more about the planning phase and get involved!

records.name: McLaren Park - Visitacion Avenue Pedestrian and Bicycle Safety Improvements
records.summary: This project will improve safety and accessibility for pedestrians and cyclists on the segment of Visitacion Avenue within McLaren Park between Mansell and Hahn streets.

records.name: McLaren Park - Yosemite Creek Daylighting Project
records.summary: Rec and Park, in partnership with SFPUC, is daylighting the historic Yosemite Creek in McLaren Park and piloting a high efficiency irrigation/stormwater reuse system at the Louis Sutter playfield
